infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: DeerAge uses the camera to capture new photos inside the app for your projects.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: DeerAge accesses your photo library so you can move media between the app and your library.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: DeerAge saves media you export from the app into your photo library.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: DeerAge uses your location to show nearby content and services while you use the app.
